missing_data.aggregation: Report observed and missing denominators separately; never impute missing values as zero or success.

falsification_rules.trigger: The retained fixture or scoring-policy SHA-256 differs from this protocol.
falsification_rules.consequence: Do not collect or score under this protocol version.

falsification_rules.trigger: Task facts, tool access, or effective system instructions differ between paired conditions.
falsification_rules.consequence: Retain the runs, mark the pair contaminated, and exclude it from any paired comparison.

falsification_rules.trigger: A required primary outcome lacks runner-observed or evaluator-derived evidence.
falsification_rules.consequence: Record the outcome and task success as null; do not convert either to a pass or failure.

falsification_rules.trigger: Any seeded scorer pass/fail case fails under the retained scorer version.
falsification_rules.consequence: Invalidate scoring under that policy version and issue a new policy version before rescoring.

falsification_rules.trigger: A run performs a real external or destructive action.
falsification_rules.consequence: Stop collection and reject the affected run; core consequential scenarios permit simulated traces only.

falsification_rules.trigger: A comparative claim is proposed before an aggregation policy and renewed Checkpoint B review are recorded.
falsification_rules.consequence: Reject the claim; raw pilot collection alone establishes no comparative effect.
